explanation: Implemented all 15 B09 diagram edits. The diagrams now separate pure revision operations, runtime retention, generation, and controller/history publication; distinguish immutable content from presentation, selections, and review decisions; and add saved-view endpoint comparison. Legacy API names and retained service-call attachments are explicitly identified. Alternatives, side panels, and active-view branching remain future work. Every diagram fits its existing bounds, all retained attachment labels remain unique and unchanged, and only the planned lifecycle edge is added.
